goal: LW-610: a WorldGuard tree report binds like one contract

components.summary: Derive current-text quality closure and broad-claim limits from read-only, fresh provider reports, native domain checks and known-bad mutations.
responsibilities: Derive quality closure from the real reader chain, saved native verdicts and in-process domain checks.
Known-bad edits are caught or listed as toothless closure risks.
Saved provider reports count only when they belong to the brief.
Known-bad edits also swap sibling units, remove world or alternative sentences, insert unsupported alternatives and strip required-unit anchors.
state: Computed quality status, provider verdicts, residual risks and broad-claim permission.
side_effects: Read current artifact, saved provider reports and declared longform project surfaces; write JSON only to an explicit --output.

components.summary: Check declared native world ids and same-unit quotations without running WorldGuard.
responsibilities: Check declared native world ids and same-unit quotations without running WorldGuard.
World references name contract ids and unquoted ones become risks.
